s1|14750.text: Interior of a retail store checkout area with a glass display counter, cash register/monitor, shelves of small packaged goods behind the counter, and additional product racks to the right and left.

Person A stands on the customer side of the counter wearing a camouflage-pattern jacket, blue pants, a dark cap, and a light-colored face covering or scarf. Person A holds a small dark object near the torso with one hand at times; the object is unclear.

Person B is behind the counter wearing a dark outer layer over a peach/orange top and a light-colored face covering. Person B moves from the right side behind the counter toward the register area and then remains behind the counter facing the customer area.

Person C is visible near the lower right/customer area wearing a black-and-white striped top. Person C faces the counter, raises both hands with palms up or outward, then lowers and moves down/left out of the main view.
Another partially visible person is near the lower center foreground with dark clothing and long hair; only the upper body/head area is visible before moving out of view toward the lower edge.
Person B steps leftward behind the counter toward the register/monitor area.
Person A extends an arm toward the counter while facing Person B; Person B faces forward behind the counter. No clear handoff is visible.
Person C raises both hands in front of the body, palms appearing up/outward, while looking toward the counter area.
Person A lifts a hand toward the face/neck area, appearing to adjust or touch the light-colored face covering or scarf.
Person A walks rightward across the front of the counter, passing between the camera and the counter area.
Person C moves downward and leftward, leaving the main visible area at the lower left edge.
Person A slows and stops near the right/customer side of the counter, facing generally toward the counter and Person B.
Person B remains behind the register/monitor area, facing forward toward the customer side of the counter.
